area: AREA 6: speech-hole faults at plan time (projected G-HOLE gate, hold-trim + narrator micro-line cures, step-05 bounded auto-trim, ONE PER TAKE interplay)
summary: Root problem: the plan battery (scripts/episode/plan_check.py) never computes speech holes — the first hole check is studio/speech_gap.refusal at step 05, AFTER plan.verdict.json is signed, so ep18 shipped a plan projecting a 12.52 s hole that only timeline.py could refuse. Measured on ep17/ep18: a hole's projected length at plan_gates.series_rate matches the measured hole to within 0.04 s (ep17 4.70→4.73 s, ep18 5.50→5.54 s; ep18's plan.json.bak_hole projects its 12.5 s hole exactly), because a hole contains no spoken words — its length is only HANDLE/BREATH/beat_s/coda_s constants plus episode_timeline.on_frame ceiling (≤1/24 s per shot boundary), so a 0.5 s margin is 10x the observed error and aligns with plan_cures' existing HOLE_WALL_S-0.5 target. Mechanism: (a) a G-HOLE battery gate that literally reuses episode_timeline.place with projected line seconds {l.index: l.words()/rate} and speech_gap's gap math (the cure measures like the checker); (b) cure order inside plan_cures.holds — an exact-projection hole trimmer replacing today's approximate step 3b (floors: wordless shots keep coda_s>=0.5 for the contract's no-line-no-beat rule and G-STORY wordless-tail, pre-button shot keeps beat_s>=1.0), then, only for residual holes, an LLM narrator micro-line (8-14 words, grounded in the shot's source span, QUOTE-gate-checked via spec.lifted_run<=QUOTE_WALL) spliced into lines with deterministic reindexing and answer remap; (c) step 05 catches a measured refusal, runs a bounded trim on measured hole boundaries, re-runs respot+timeline exactly once, re-runs the free battery and re-signs via plan_verdict.sign only on clean, else refuses. The ONE PER TAKE interplay is closed by making holds' pair-growth (step 1) hole-aware: every coda/beat addition is capped by that silence's hole headroom, and a pair with zero silence headroom is split by the micro-line (speech splits a take without opening silence).

gates.where: studio/plan_gates.py — new functions projected_place(episode, rate) and hole_faults(episode, rate) placed after rate_advisory (~line 1055); wired into scripts/episode/plan_check.py main() as a HARD section immediately after the ONE PER TAKE block (after line 250: `hard += len(packed)`), printed as `G-HOLE       :` with rows via `print("   ", f[:170])` so plan_repair.fault_rows collects them
gates.rule: projected_place(episode, rate) = studio.episode_timeline.place(episode, {l.index: l.words()/rate for l in episode.lines}) — the REAL placement function fed projected seconds, zero drift from step 05. hole_faults runs studio.speech_gap.over_wall(placed_like, wall=speech_gap.MAX_GAP_S - speech_gap.HOLE_MARGIN_S) and emits one plan_gates.fault row per hole: fault("G-HOLE", f"shots {first}-{last}", f"projected hole in speech from {start:.2f} s", round(end-start,2), round(wall,2)) — the words 'hole in speech' are load-bearing: plan_cures.CURES row 335 already routes that text to the holds cure. New constant in studio/speech_gap.py: HOLE_MARGIN_S = 0.5 with docstring quoting the measured deltas (ep17 projected 4.70 vs measured 4.73; ep18 5.50 vs 5.54; pre-fix ep18 bak_hole 12.5 projected = 12.52 refused) and the mechanism (hole length is word-free: HANDLE 0.25 x2 + BREATH 0.70 + beat_s + coda_s + on_frame ceil <= 1/24 s/shot — rate error never enters a hole). Also new speech_gap.over_wall(placed, wall) -> list[(start, end, shot_indices)] generalizing refusal() (lines 30-42) to ALL holes over a given wall; refusal() is rewritten as the largest-hole special case of over_wall at MAX_GAP_S so step 05 and QC keep their exact behavior. NOT added to plan_gates.faults() (it needs rate, like G-RATE); plan_check.main computes rate once at line 201 already.

gates.id: G-HOLE-05 (measured, existing wall, new bounded auto-cure)
gates.where: scripts/episode/step_05_timeline.py run() (lines 54-58) around the existing speech_gap.refusal check; done() (line 48-51) unchanged
gates.rule: run() becomes: respot + timeline; if speech_gap.refusal(placed): (1) refuse outright if any take is rendered (any((ctx.home/'takes'/'r2v').glob('T??.mp4')) — same guard as step_02_plan.rendered, a plan under rendered takes is never edited); (2) else doc = episode_home.read_json(plan), trimmed = plan_cures.trim_measured_holes(doc, placed) (bounded: only beat_s/coda_s of shots intersecting measured holes, floors as in the cure table, trims at most hole_len - (MAX_GAP_S - HOLE_MARGIN_S) per hole, inserts nothing); if trimmed: episode_home.write_plan (contract-validated; lapses plan.verdict.json by sha8), re-run respot + timeline ONCE; (3) re-check: still refused -> raise SystemExit(why). (4) on clean: rc,out = ctx.capture_script('scripts/episode/plan_check.py'); rc==0 -> plan_verdict.sign(plan, note=f'step 05 measured-hole trim ({n} holds shaved); battery clean', signed_by=studio.judges.plan JUDGE@VERSION signer string — the same identity plan_ladder.Desk.sign (line 244-248) uses, never the owner's); rc!=0 -> SystemExit listing the battery rows (drive returns to step 02, where the judge ladder re-signs). This is the no-human-input path: a deterministic trim + the free deterministic battery + the plan judge's own signature.

gates.id: G-HOLE x ONE PER TAKE interplay guard
gates.where: studio/plan_cures.py holds() step 1 (lines 236-249, the pair-growth loop) and plan_check.py packed_shots (line 88) / studio/episode_takes.groups (lines 71-93)
gates.rule: Hold edits move episode_takes.groups packing both ways: growing a pair's coda past BUDGET=8.0 splits a take but can open a >wall hole; trimming a hole can re-pack two shots into one take, and plan_repair's 6-round loop oscillates. Fix inside holds(): before each `add` in step 1, compute headroom = (MAX_GAP_S - HOLE_MARGIN_S) - current_hole_length for the hole that shot's silence sits in (via the shared projected placement, recomputed after each write) and cap add = min(need, room, 1.2, headroom). A pair whose every slot has headroom <= 0 is left packed and holds() returns it in a new second return value `unsplit: list[tuple[int,int]]`; plan_repair routes unsplit pairs to the micro-line path — adding 8-14 words (3.2-5.6 s of SPEECH at the measured ~2.5 w/s) to the pair's line-light shot splits the take without any new silence. Test locks both directions: after holds(), groups(projected) has no multi-shot run AND over_wall(projection, wall) is empty on the same doc.

cures.fault: G-HOLE (projected hole over 5.5 s) — mechanical first
cures.how: Replace plan_cures.holds() step 3b (lines 283-305, the approximate coda+unvoiced-run model that misses beat_s, the 2xHANDLE seam, and voiced-to-voiced holes) with _close_projected_holes(doc, rate): (1) ep = Episode.model_validate(doc); placed = plan_gates.projected_place(ep, rate) — the checker's own numbers; (2) for each (start, end, shot_ids) in speech_gap.over_wall(placed, wall=MAX_GAP_S - HOLE_MARGIN_S): over = (end-start) - wall; collect slots [(shot, key, floor)] for every plan shot whose [t_start,t_end) intersects the hole, floors: voiced shot -> beat_s floor 0.0, coda_s floor 0.0; WORDLESS shot (no line in doc['lines']) -> coda_s floor 0.5 and beat_s floor 0.0 (keeps the contract's 'carries no line and names no beat: a hole' validator truthy and the G-STORY wordless-tail arithmetic intact); the shot BEFORE the button line's shot -> beat_s floor 1.0 (contract rule at episode_spec line 709); the button shot -> coda_s floor 0.6 (BUTTON_REST_S advisory); (3) shave largest holds first: for (s,key,floor) sorted by -(value-floor): cut = round(min(over, value-floor),2); (4) recompute placement, loop holes, guard <= 8 passes. Dispatch unchanged: CURES line 335 regex already matches 'hole in speech'; add 'G-HOLE' to that row's pattern for clarity. Each function 10-20 lines: _hole_slots(doc, shot_ids), _floors(doc), _shave(slots, over), _close_projected_holes.

cures.fault: G-HOLE residual (trimming to floors cannot close the hole, e.g. a run of wordless shots whose handles alone exceed the wall) and holds()'s unsplit ONE PER TAKE pairs
cures.how: New agents/line_filler.py + plan_cures.insert_line, driven by plan_repair.main after the mechanical rounds (insert between lines 134 and 135): partition the final battery rows; rows matching 'G-HOLE' (and unsplit pairs returned by holds) are LLM-curable, not creative. fill_holes(book, number, doc, max_inserts=3): for each residual hole, chooser plan_cures.insertion_shot(doc, hole, rate): candidates = shots intersecting the hole with < MAX_LINES_PER_SHOT(=2) lines (wordless preferred), index strictly < the button line's shot (contract: no line after the button; inserting ON the button shot would also break 'the last line plays on the button shot'), and whose post-insert seconds 2*HANDLE + (existing_words+w)/rate + BREATH*n_lines + beat+coda <= episode_takes.BUDGET (8.0) at w=14; pick the candidate minimizing max(left_subhole, right_subhole) where the new line lands at shot.t_start + HANDLE (+ existing lines + BREATH if the shot already carries one); no candidate -> leave the row creative. Call: text = line_filler.fill(ctx) using studio.llm.structured('local', PROMPT, MicroLine, _agent=seam) — guard_spend fires automatically inside _NativeStructuredCaller._parse (llm.py line 184); MicroLine(BaseModel) validators (each its own 10-line model_validator): 8-14 words, no parentheses (Line's own rule), does not end in '!' (G-SHOUT: a narration shout is refused), <= MAX_WORDS. Post-checks in fill (the book is needed, so outside the schema): spec.lifted_run(text, seq_boards.book_words(book)) <= QUOTE_WALL(=8) and spec.slow_word(text) is None; on breach re-ask once via llm.re_ask with the refusal quoted, then give up (row stays creative). Grounding: the shot's own source spans; source_paragraph = the paragraph plan_gates.span_paragraph places the shot's LATEST span on (plan_gates.event_paragraph), from plan_brief.chapter_paragraphs(book, number). Splice — the EXACT reindex algorithm (plan_cures.insert_line(doc, shot_index, text, speaker)): speaker = the first existing narration line's speaker (no narration anywhere -> refuse insertion); p = next((k for k,l in enumerate(doc['lines']) if l['shot'] > shot_index), len(doc['lines'])) — lines are contract-sorted by shot, so p lands AFTER every existing line of shot_index, which preserves G-SYNC (a dialogue line stays first on its shot) and keeps the button the last element; doc['lines'].insert(p, {'index': -1, 'kind': 'narration', 'speaker': speaker, 'text': text, 'shot': shot_index, 'delivery': ''}); then for k,l in enumerate(doc['lines']): l['index'] = k (0..n-1 playback order, the contract's numbering rule); remap doc['answer']: if it matches episode_spec.ANSWER as ('line', N) and N >= p -> f'line {N+1}' ('shot N' answers, omit, and beds reference shots and are untouched). Then episode_home.write_plan and one more battery round. G-RATE guard: skip insertion when words/series_rate pushes the measured-rate projection past MAX_SECONDS (173.x s) — that residual IS creative (the plan must lose picture, the writer's call).
cures.est_cost_usd: ~0.001/episode (gpt-5.6-luna, tier 'local': ~1,500 tokens in at $0.20/M + ~60 out at $1.20/M = ~$0.0004/call, <= 3 calls; retries double it at worst; all under guard_spend against money.episode_ceiling_usd=3.00)

cures.fault: measured hole at step 05 (speech_gap.refusal after the voice renders)
cures.how: plan_cures.trim_measured_holes(doc, placed): identical shave algorithm and floors as _close_projected_holes but hole boundaries and shot intersections come from placed.json's measured t_start/t_end/lines (speech_gap.over_wall(placed, wall=MAX_GAP_S - HOLE_MARGIN_S) — trimming to the margin below the 6.0 wall so the once-only re-time has headroom); BOUNDED: trims only, never inserts, never touches a shot outside a hole, total cut per hole <= hole_len - wall, respects every floor; returns the number of holds shaved (0 = nothing trimmable -> step 05 refuses immediately with the original refusal text, which plan_repair's table routes when drive falls back to the plan step). Wired per gate G-HOLE-05 above: one trim, one respot+timeline re-run, battery, judge-signed re-sign or SystemExit.

files.change: Add HOLE_MARGIN_S = 0.5 (docstring: ep17 projected 4.70 vs measured 4.73, ep18 5.50 vs 5.54, ep18 bak_hole 12.5 projected = 12.52 refused; hole length is word-free so only on_frame ceiling <= 1/24 s per shot boundary separates projection from measure). Add over_wall(placed, wall) -> list[(start, end, shot_indices)] for every hole over `wall`; rewrite refusal() (lines 30-42) on top of it at MAX_GAP_S, byte-identical refusal text.

Add projected_place(episode, rate) = episode_timeline.place(episode, {l.index: l.words()/rate}) and hole_faults(episode, rate) emitting G-HOLE fault rows containing the phrase 'hole in speech' (after rate_advisory, ~line 1055). Not in faults() — rate-parameterized like G-RATE.

In main(), after the ONE PER TAKE block (line 250): hf = plan_gates.hole_faults(ep, rate); print('G-HOLE       :', len(hf) or 'clean'); hard += len(hf); rows printed with the 4-space indent fault_rows collects.

Replace holds() step 3b (lines 283-305) with _close_projected_holes(doc, rate) measuring via Episode.model_validate + plan_gates.projected_place + speech_gap.over_wall; make step 1's pair growth (lines 236-249) hole-headroom-capped and have holds() also report unsplit pairs; add trim_measured_holes(doc, placed); add insertion_shot(doc, hole, rate) and insert_line(doc, shot_index, text, speaker) with the reindex + answer-remap algorithm; add 'G-HOLE' to the CURES holds row (line 335). Every new function 10-20 lines, one job.

NEW: MicroLine pydantic model (text; validators: 8-14 words, no parentheses, no trailing '!', <= MAX_WORDS) + fill(shot_ctx, source_paragraph, prev_text, next_text, gap_s, book_words, _agent=None) -> str | None calling studio.llm.structured('local', PROMPT, MicroLine, _agent=_agent); post-checks lifted_run <= QUOTE_WALL and slow_word is None with one llm.re_ask retry. Book-neutral; typed inputs in, a string out.

After the mechanical round loop (between lines 134 and 139): partition remaining rows; G-HOLE rows (and holds' unsplit pairs) go to fill_holes(book, number, max_inserts=3) -> line_filler.fill + plan_cures.insert_line + episode_home.write_plan, then one final battery; only rows that survive both paths print as CREATIVE.

run() (lines 54-58): on speech_gap.refusal — refuse if takes rendered; else trim_measured_holes -> write_plan -> respot+timeline re-run ONCE -> re-check (fail: SystemExit(why)) -> capture_script plan_check (free) -> clean: plan_verdict.sign with the plan judge's signer (as plan_ladder.Desk.sign lines 244-248 does), else SystemExit with battery rows.

tests: tests/test_speech_gap_over_wall.py — over_wall returns every hole over a given wall with its shot indices on a hand-built placed dict; refusal() still returns the byte-identical sentence for the largest hole at MAX_GAP_S; HOLE_MARGIN_S == 0.5.

tests/test_hole_gate_measures_like_step05.py — build a contract-valid synthetic Episode fixture (derived from the contract, book-neutral) with a wordless run projecting a 7+ s hole; plan_gates.hole_faults fires at wall 5.5 with 'hole in speech' in the row text; feeding the SAME per-line seconds to episode_timeline.place and to projected_place yields identical holes (the gate IS step 05's measure); plan_cures.cure_for(row) == 'holds'.

tests/test_close_projected_holes.py — the rewritten holds() closes a 12 s projected hole (ep18-shaped: voiced shot + three wordless shots); after cure: over_wall(projection, 5.5) empty; every wordless shot keeps coda_s >= 0.5; pre-button shot keeps beat_s >= 1.0; Episode.model_validate accepts the doc; also the ep16-shaped voiced-coda hole (old 3b's case) still closes.

tests/test_holds_pair_hole_interplay.py — a consecutive same-setup pair whose split-growth would open a > 5.5 s hole: holds() caps the growth at headroom and returns the pair in `unsplit`; a pair WITH headroom is grown past BUDGET and episode_takes.groups(projection) shows every shot its own take while over_wall stays empty (both gates clean on one doc).

tests/test_insert_line.py — insert_line on a mid-plan wordless shot: indices come back 0..n-1, insertion lands after every existing line of that shot (G-SYNC holds), button line stays last, 'answer': 'line N' remapped iff N >= insertion point, 'shot N' answers and beds untouched; refused on shots >= the button line's shot and on shots already carrying 2 lines; Episode.model_validate accepts the result.

tests/test_insertion_shot.py — the chooser picks the shot minimizing the larger sub-hole; respects the take BUDGET arithmetic at 14 words; returns None when no candidate exists (all shots at 2 lines, or only post-button shots in the hole).

tests/test_line_filler.py — a FakeCaller injected via _agent returns canned MicroLine JSON: fill() returns the text with ZERO network; a canned 9-word lift over QUOTE_WALL triggers exactly one re_ask (the fake asserts the REFUSED heading and serves a clean second answer); a schema-refused 7-word line raises StructuredOutputException through llm.structured's retry ladder; MicroLine refuses 7 and 15 words, '(grey eyes)', and a trailing '!'. No test touches a paid API.

tests/test_trim_measured_holes.py — on a placed dict with a measured 8 s hole: trims to <= 5.5, never below floors, never touches shots outside the hole, returns 0 (and leaves the doc byte-equal) when every slot is at its floor.

tests/test_step05_autotrim_once.py — unit-test the step's decision function (extracted pure): rendered takes -> refuse untrimmed; trimmable -> exactly one re-run requested; post-rerun still-refused -> SystemExit carries speech_gap.refusal's text; the sign path is taken only on battery rc==0 (battery stubbed as a canned (rc, out), plan_verdict.sign monkeypatched and asserted signed_by is the plan judge, never 'owner').
risks: Oscillation between the hole trimmer and the pair-splitter inside plan_repair's 6-round loop if the headroom cap is implemented after rather than inside step 1's add loop — the cap must be recomputed from the projection after every single add, not once per round.

plan.verdict.json lapse at step 05: between write_plan and the re-sign, a crash leaves an unsigned plan with a fresh placed.json; drive then re-enters step 02, whose ran_downstream/grandfathered logic (grandfathered = ran AND no verdict FILE) sees a STALE verdict file and re-judges via the ladder — correct but costs one critic call; acceptable, document in the step docstring.

insert_line changes lines.json requirements: new lines need voicing, so insertion is only legal while step 04 outputs are not yet the bottleneck — plan_repair runs at step 02 (pre-voice) so this holds; the step-05 path deliberately NEVER inserts (trim-only) because its lines are already rendered.

The 0.5 s margin is calibrated on ep17/ep18 only; if a future episode's measured hole exceeds its projection by more (e.g. a renderer that pads line wavs), step 05's bounded trim is the backstop — but log the measured-vs-projected delta per episode (one line in timeline.py's print) so the constant keeps a world attached (constants-outlive-their-world).
Micro-line delivery defaults to '' (calm); a hole inside an 'urgent' span gets a calm bridge — accepted: one field, writer-grade judgement, out of scope for a $0.0004 call.

MAX_BEAT 1.5 + MAX_CODA 4.0 + 2xHANDLE = 6.5 s means a SINGLE maxed-out voiced shot can breach the 6.0 wall by itself; the trimmer handles it, but consider a follow-up contract advisory (not refusal — ep01-16 plans must still load) flagging beat_s+coda_s > 5.0 on one shot.
